conditions_stated.value: Testable version: (A) Bullish default. While no 4h candle closes decisively bearish (operationalized: no 4h close below the Fri 5 Jul range low ≈5,585), look for ES longs on a pullback to ≈5,605.5 (0.5 of 5,585-5,626), targeting new highs above 5,626. (B) Bearish switch. Once 4h bearish closes or a bearish 4h shift appear (ideally Mon-Wed), expect ES to retrace into 5,569.5-5,585.75, then 5,541-5,560, with the 5,510.50 swing low as sell-side liquidity below. Then drop to lower timeframes and look for price to raid levels at high-probability times. He gives no entry, stop or target numbers for either case.
